scenes.audio: What would happen if you were born in the year 3000?
scenes.visual: Translucent glowing skeletal baby on futuristic medical platform in high-tech lab; robotic arms with glowing tips emitting sparks/beams; cool blue, holographic medical displays.
FLASH-FORWARD: ~18-year-old translucent cyborg version of the avatar with glowing internals floats in dark space near rocks; bright purple crystal behind.

scenes.audio: Day one: You're not born in a hospital.
scenes.visual: Skeletal baby inside vertical glass incubation tube of blue liquid holding colorful swirl lollipop; rows of tubes; DNA double-helix holograms.

scenes.audio: You're printed in a bio-lab.
scenes.visual: Back to baby on platform; four robotic arms scanning/assembling the translucent infant with blue beams.

scenes.audio: Your parents customize your stats like a video game character...
scenes.visual: Holographic control panel with sliders 'Intelligence', 'Athletic Ability', 'Creativity'; baby suspended in cylinder behind; colorful energy arcs link interface and child.

scenes.audio: ...while an AI nurse watches.
scenes.visual: Vast futuristic nursery of glass pods; sleek white humanoid AI nurse with glowing eyes reaches toward a pod; futuristic city through windows.

scenes.audio: Year 5: School doesn't exist anymore.
scenes.visual: Older glowing skeletal child on reclined bed; view of space-city; holographic solar system floating above bed.

scenes.audio: Knowledge chips upload directly into your brain while you sleep.
scenes.visual: Translucent skull with glowing gold chip in brain; binary-like particles flow out; energy pulses.

scenes.audio: You wake up speaking 30 languages...
scenes.visual: Child jumps on bed in futuristic room; glowing brain hologram overhead with speech bubbles in foreign scripts; sunlight.

scenes.audio: ...but still can't figure out why your holographic dog keeps glitching.
scenes.visual: Child in colorful lab-like room with slightly translucent holographic golden retriever; floating red spheres.
Child runs down futuristic hallway with glowing floor, holographic dog alongside; bright sterile blue.

scenes.audio: Year 18: Your first job is mining asteroids for rare metals in space.
scenes.visual: Teen translucent cyborg in utility vest and headlamp floats in dark cave reaching for glowing purple crystal.
Character floats in open space among asteroids; red holographic HUD with status bars superimposed.

scenes.audio: You take a teleporter to work every morning like it's a subway.
scenes.visual: Character in white futuristic armor walks through crowded high-tech transit; uses wrist hologram; human and robot commuters.

scenes.audio: Your manager still sends you pointless emails...
scenes.visual: Character in astronaut suit (skeletal face visible through visor) in space; blue circular portal opens behind; holds white briefcase.

scenes.audio: ...even though you're literally floating in zero gravity.
scenes.visual: Armored character floats in asteroid field with drill/scanner tool; high contrast black space and starlight.

scenes.audio: Year 35: You take a vacation to the theme park on Mars.
scenes.visual: Character in brown jacket and silver helmet before large gate of Mars colony; rockets and fireworks; lollipop icon in the sky.
Character in red convertible flying through space near Mars, hands up in excitement.

scenes.audio: There's a ride where you launch a car into space over and over.
scenes.visual: Character in thruster-car roller coaster launched along track toward large rocket on launchpad.

scenes.audio: The holographic tour guide looks exactly like him...
scenes.visual: Inside Mars glass dome, character beside flickering blue hologram of a man (short dark hair, grey t-shirt, jeans) gesturing enthusiastically. [Real-person allusion — not to be reproduced.]

scenes.audio: ...and won't stop talking about rockets.
scenes.visual: Character facepalms as hologram keeps following and talking; orange planet through window.

scenes.audio: Year 80: Scientists discover Earth was actually a simulation all along.
scenes.visual: Character now heavily modified cyborg, tattered clothes, mechanical parts, in dark control room with scientists; giant holographic Earth.
Cyborg reaches toward holographic Earth, which glitches into wireframe.

scenes.audio: They find the edge of the universe and it's just lines of code.
scenes.visual: Character against wall of green scrolling code, trying to touch/break through; dark with green highlights.

scenes.audio: A giant message appears in the sky: Simulation ending in 24 hours.
scenes.visual: Huge red glowing sky text 'SIMULATION ENDING IN 24 HOURS' over post-apocalyptic city; character center street arms raised; people panic; red light.

scenes.audio: Everyone realizes their entire existence...
scenes.visual: Character holds head in despair; floating countdown 23:59:59; binary code and crumbling city.

scenes.audio: ...was just someone's experiment.
scenes.visual: Character falls to knees in digital void under green code rain; reflective floor mirrors skyline; looks up toward red light at top of frame.
